strategy_roster.name: ExpBuySellSide
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > sma(close,30) + 2.5 * atr(high,low,close,5) and sma(close,2) > sma(close,30) and roc(sma(close,2),1) > roc(sma(close,30),1)
strategy_roster.exit_long: close < sma(close,30) - 2.5 * atr(high,low,close,5) or sma(close,2) < sma(close,30)
strategy_roster.notes: ATR(5) bands are centered on SMA(30) as a proxy for the source bands, with SMA(2)/SMA(30) separation and spread expansion retained. The short branch, close-opposite state, and dynamic ATR protection are not represented by this long-only DSL entry.

strategy_roster.name: JBrainTrend ReOpen
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) replaces the documented Stochastic oscillator because Stochastic is not available; the 20/80 extremes retain the stated mean-reversion levels. Pyramiding, absolute-price stop/target values, and the original smoothing periods are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: SuperTrend SDI Webhook
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > ema(close,10) and roc(ema(close,10),1) > 0 and adx(high,low,close,14) > 20
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(10) slope approximates the SuperTrend direction and ADX(14)>20 proxies +DI dominance; the documented ATR/SDI parameters and 5-minute stream are unavailable. The explicit 4.8% stop and 25% target are retained, while trailing-stop management is omitted.

strategy_roster.name: VWAP RSI Scalper FINAL v1
strategy_roster.entry_long: rsi(close,3) < 35 and close < sma(close * volume,20) / sma(volume,20) and close < ema(close,50)
strategy_roster.notes: A 20-bar volume-weighted close proxy stands in for VWAP; the long branch uses the documented RSI(3) oversold level and EMA(50) pullback. Session limits, daily trade count, and ATR stop/target execution are not DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: ThinkTech AI Signals
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > donchian_high_prev(high,1) and ema(close,20) > ema(close,50) and rsi(close,14) > 50
strategy_roster.notes: A prior-candle high break substitutes for the first 15-minute range, with EMA(20)/EMA(50) and RSI(14)>50 as documented-style filters. ATR(14) stops/targets, session timing, and exact optional filter settings cannot be expressed as fixed percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Yesterday Today
strategy_roster.notes: The prior-bar high/low are a single-bar proxy for yesterday's daily range, retaining the close-break and mirrored exit intent. Daily aggregation, pip sizing, and the documented 50-pip stop/target are unavailable in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Combo Strategy 123 Reversal & Fractal Chaos Bands
strategy_roster.notes: Bollinger(15,2) approximates the Fractal Chaos Band and RSI(14)<30 approximates the bullish 123 reversal component. The custom pattern, Stochastic smoothing, band construction, and opposite-signal permissions are not directly available.

strategy_roster.name: Commission Calculator
strategy_roster.notes: The documented strategy is a one-order fee-accounting utility with no market-data signal, so an impossible positive-price guard avoids fabricating entries. Manual order mode, commission reporting, and absolute stop/target levels are outside the trading DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Parabolic SAR Bug 3
strategy_roster.notes: An EMA(20) plus/minus ATR(14) channel approximates the Parabolic SAR side and its flip. The source's SAR-point stop and target require instrument-step scaling, so they remain null; the opposite side and first-dot state are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Vortex Oscillator System
strategy_roster.notes: A 14-bar close z-score rising through the documented -0.75 buy region approximates the Vortex inflection, with the 0.00 take-profit level as the exit. Vortex construction and oscillator-based stop levels are not expressible as percentage fields.
